title: MWS 3-year resurvey — Demographics
description: Administrative fields recorded at the 3-year ('yellow') resurvey: which questionnaire version was completed, and when.

F1QTYPE.title: Questionnaire version completed (3-year resurvey)
F1QTYPE.description: A code determining which version of the 1st resurvey questionnaire (yellow) was completed.
F1QTYPE.$comment: Source coding: 1=9903, 2=9907, 3=9909, 4=0012 -- these are the study's own internal version/batch codes (not calendar dates), each with its own fielding-year window per SOURCES.md (9903: 1998-1999, 9907: 1999, 9909: 1999-2004, 0012: 2000-2005). A genuinely different versioning scheme from RQTYPE's Aqua/Blue/Other in the recruitment table, not just a relabeling.

F1YSUBMT.title: Year questionnaire completed
F1YSUBMT.$comment: Bound removed entirely -- the earlier agent-decided/derived plausibility bound was retired per Montse's dictionary-fidelity requirement (D101-D104) (both the source-derived minimum and the steward-directed maximum, D048, were a synthesis of separate facts, not a number the dictionary itself states).
